// diagnostic

E0075

This collecting loop cannot use a break payload.

What

This collecting loop cannot use a break payload.

Why

Its result is already the accumulated `[T]`. A second payload would give the same exit two result channels.

Fix

Write `break` to return the accumulated list, or return one final value from an ordinary loop.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0075: tests/ui/yielding_loop_break_payload.stderr.

Error [E0075]: this collecting loop cannot use a break payload
  --> tests/ui/yielding_loop_break_payload.jet:3:20
    |
  3 |         if x > 1 { break 9 }
    |                    ^^^^^
 Why: its result is already the accumulated List, so a second payload would give one exit two result channels
 Fix: write `break` to return the accumulated list
